purpose: Record concrete original student-facing activity-to-digital/teacher-task parity discrepancies. Reviewed summaries are an aid to manual A-D acceptance, not academic approval.
provenance: Read-only original 2021 local teacher/student HTML with matching hashes from full-grade-original-student-facing-task-inventory.json, paired with repository Practice source.
limitations: Teacher/full Student Facing HTML index is abbreviated; drawings, source PDF artwork, digital UI runtime for exact head, licensed graphics and actual physical pupil work have not been fully audited. Some newly corrected paths are still undergoing GitHub CI. No original 1-50 lesson changes.
